question: The main objective of the industry base Memorandum Scheme is _________. (RPF SI(06/01/2019) Shift 1)
options: Encouraging entrepreneurship and promoting start-up
Facilitating a relationship between future job seekers and employers
Promote ease of doing business
Setting up a network of technology and emerging centers
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Promote ease of doing business

Explanation:
The Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) scheme was introduced by the Government of India to promote ease of doing business in the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector. This scheme allows entrepreneurs to register their business by simply filing a simple online form, eliminating complex procedures. Its main objective is to reduce regulatory burden and facilitate starting and operating a business. The scheme falls under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) and is free of cost.

☛ In which year was the UAM scheme launched? → 2015
☛ Who can benefit from the UAM scheme? → Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs)
question_hi: उद्योग आधार ज्ञापन योजना का मुख्य उद्देश्य _________ है। (RPF SI(06/01/2019) Shift 1)
options_hi: उद्यमशीलता को प्रोत्साहित करना और स्टार्ट-अप को बढ़ावा देना

Explanation:

question: Announcement of new Foreign Trade Policy in India has been done for the year ________. (RPF SI(06/01/2019) Shift 2)
options: 2016 - 21
2017 - 22
2014 - 19
2015 - 20
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 2015 - 20

Explanation:
The Government of India announced the new Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) 2015-20 on 1 April 2015. This policy was implemented for a period of 5 years (2015-2020). Its objective was to boost exports, ensure ease of doing business, and strengthen India's position in global competition. The FTP 2015-20 supported initiatives like 'Make in India' and 'Digital India'. The policy provided various incentives to exporters, such as MEIS (Merchandise Exports from India Scheme) and SEIS (Services Exports from India Scheme). The term of this policy lasted until 2020, after which the new FTP 2021-26 was implemented.

☛ Which scheme was included under FTP 2015-20? → MEIS (Merchandise Exports from India Scheme)
☛ When did the new Foreign Trade Policy 2021-26 come into effect? → 1 April 2021
☛ Which scheme was for service exports under FTP 2015-20? → SEIS (Services Exports from India Scheme)
☛ For how many years was FTP 2015-20? → 5 years

options_hi: 2016 - 21

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है 2015 - 20

Explanation:

question: Which of the following is an in-situ conservation measure taken by India? (RRB JE ME (29/08/2019) Shift 1 CBT 2)
options: Project Lion
All of the options
Project Rhino
Project Elephant
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is All of the options

Explanation:
In-situ conservation refers to the conservation of species in their natural habitats. India has implemented several projects for different species, such as Project Lion (Gir National Park, Gujarat), Project Rhino (Kaziranga National Park, Assam), and Project Elephant (various states). All these are examples of in-situ conservation because they protect animals in their natural environment. Hence, all the given options are in-situ conservation measures, making 'All of the options' the correct answer.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ What is in-situ conservation? → Conservation of species in their natural habitat.
☛ Where is Project Lion located? → Gir National Park, Gujarat.
☛ In which state is Project Rhino located? → Assam (Kaziranga National Park).
☛ When was Project Elephant launched? → 1992.
☛ Examples of in-situ conservation? → National parks, wildlife sanctuaries, biosphere reserves.

question: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana was launched in April, 2015 to support and promote- (RRB JE ME (31/08/2019) CBT 2)
options: Oil production
Organic farming
Wheat agriculture
Vegetable farming
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Organic farming

Explanation:
The Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) was launched in April 2015 to promote organic farming. This scheme encourages farmers to use natural and organic inputs instead of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. PKVY aims to improve soil fertility, maintain environmental sustainability, and provide market access for organic products. Under this scheme, farmers receive financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 per hectare. It is a part of the National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA). The scheme focuses on cluster-based approach and certification of organic produce.

question: What is the strategic aim of IRDP? (RRB JE (27/05/2019) Shift 3 CBT 1)
options: To provide the required input for increasing agricultural productivity
To reduce unemployment
To increase the food supply
To provide more opportunities for rural employment and credit facilities at concessional rate of interest
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is To provide more opportunities for rural employment and credit facilities at concessional rate of interest

Explanation:
IRDP stands for Integrated Rural Development Programme, launched in 1978-79. Its primary objective was poverty alleviation and employment generation in rural areas. The programme focused on providing self-employment opportunities to rural poor families by offering them subsidies and bank loans at concessional interest rates. Beneficiaries were assisted in acquiring income-generating assets (such as livestock, shops, or handicraft tools) to create sustainable livelihoods. IRDP was later merged into the Swarnajayanti Gram Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY), which further evolved into the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM).

question: Government of India has introduced 'Beti Bachao, Beti Padao' programme to address the issue of - (RRB NTPC CBT-I (18/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Freedom of Speech
Equality between different social groups
Provide health facilities to all
Decline in girl child sex-ratio
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Decline in girl child sex-ratio

Explanation:
'Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao' (BBBP) scheme was launched by the Government of India on 22 January 2015. Its primary objective is to address the issue of declining child sex ratio (CSR) and to prevent gender-biased sex selection, female infanticide, and child marriage. The program focuses on ensuring the survival, protection, and education of the girl child. It is implemented through a coordinated effort of the Ministry of Women and Child Development, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, and Ministry of Education. The scheme also aims to change societal mindsets and promote gender equality.

question: To provide at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment to every household in a financial year for unskilled manual work done by an adult is the objective of which flagship programme of the Government of India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/01/2021) Shift 1)

question_hi: एक वयस्क द्वारा किए गए अकुशल शारीरिक कार्य के लिए एक वित्तीय वर्ष में प्रत्येक परिवार को कम से कम 100 दिनों का गारंटीकृत मजदूरी रोजगार प्रदान करना भारत सरकार के किस प्रमुख कार्यक्रम का उद्देश्य है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/01/2021) Shift 1)

question: What is MPLADS? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: A scheme launched by the government of India which enables Members of Parliament to do development work in their constituencies
A scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government for the protection of ladies
A scheme launched by the Maharashtra and Punjab governments for legal assistance to deprived sections
A scheme launched by the Madhya Pradesh government for the protection of lions and other endangered species
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A scheme launched by the government of India which enables Members of Parliament to do development work in their constituencies

Explanation:
MPLADS stands for Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme. It is a central scheme launched by the Government of India in 1993 under the Ministry of Rural Development. The scheme provides an annual allocation of Rs. 5 crore to each MP to recommend development works in their constituency. The objective is to enable MPs to initiate projects based on local needs in areas such as infrastructure, education, healthcare, and community development. This empowers MPs to play a direct role in grassroots development and strengthen democratic processes. Over the years, the scheme has been continued with periodic revisions to improve transparency and implementation. It applies to both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha MPs.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of MPLADS? → Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme
☛ When was MPLADS launched? → 1993
☛ Annual allocation per MP under MPLADS? → Rs. 5 crore
☛ Which ministry administers MPLADS? → Ministry of Rural Development
☛ Can Rajya Sabha MPs utilize MPLADS? → Yes, in the state they represent

Explanation:
MPLADS का पूरा नाम सांसद स्थानीय क्षेत्र विकास योजना है। यह 1993 में भारत सरकार द्वारा शुरू की गई एक केंद्रीय योजना है, जिसके तहत प्रत्येक सांसद को अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में विकास कार्यों के लिए प्रति वर्ष 5 करोड़ रुपये का आवंटन मिलता है। इस योजना का उद्देश्य सांसदों को अपने क्षेत्र में बुनियादी ढांचे, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, और अन्य सामुदायिक परियोजनाओं की सिफारिश करने में सक्षम बनाना है। यह योजना सांसदों को लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया में सक्रिय भूमिका निभाने और क्षेत्रीय विकास को गति देने में मदद करती है। वर्तमान में इस योजना को जारी रखा गया है और समय-समय पर इसमें संशोधन किए गए हैं।

question: Name the scheme launched by the Government of India in April, 2005, that aims to provide accessible, affordable, accountable, effective and reliable primary health care especially to the poor and vulnerable sections of the population. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: NSAP
NRHM
ICDS
AYUSH
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is NRHM

Explanation:
The National Rural Health Mission (NRHM), launched by the Government of India in April 2005, aims to provide accessible, affordable, accountable, effective, and reliable primary health care, especially to the poor and vulnerable sections of the population. It is a component of the National Health Mission (NHM). NRHM includes initiatives such as ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) workers, Village Health Committees, and the Janani Suraksha Yojana. Its key focus areas are reducing maternal and infant mortality, promoting family planning, and controlling communicable diseases. The implementation of NRHM has improved the rural health infrastructure, including strengthening Primary Health Centers (PHCs) and Community Health Centers (CHCs).

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of NRHM? → National Rural Health Mission
☛ Year of launch of NRHM? → 2005
☛ Rural health workers under NRHM are called? → ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist)
☛ Objective of NRHM? → Provide accessible, affordable, accountable primary health care to poor and vulnerable sections
☛ NRHM is part of which mission? → National Health Mission (NHM)
question_hi: भारत सरकार द्वारा अप्रैल, 2005 में शुरू की गई उस योजना का नाम बताइए, जिसका उद्देश्य विशेष रूप से आबादी के गरीब और कमजोर वर्गों को सुलभ, सस्ती, जवाबदेह, प्रभावी और विश्वसनीय प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य देखभाल प्रदान करना है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (19/01/2021) Shift 2)

question: Which of the following financial inclusion schemes was launched in June 2015 to prompt the unorganised workforce to join the National Pension Scheme? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
Atal Pension Yojana
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Atal Pension Yojana

Explanation:
The Atal Pension Yojana (APY) was launched in June 2015 to encourage the unorganised workforce to join the National Pension System (NPS). It is primarily targeted at workers who are not part of any organized pension scheme. Under APY, the government contributes 50% of the subscriber's contribution for 5 years, up to ₹1000 per year. The scheme is available for individuals aged 18-40 years and guarantees a minimum pension of ₹1000 per month after the age of 60. It replaced the earlier Swavalamban Yojana and is administered by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA).

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was Atal Pension Yojana launched? → June 2015
☛ How many years does the government contribute in APY? → 5 years
☛ Maximum age limit to join APY? → 40 years
☛ Minimum guaranteed pension under APY? → ₹1000 per month
☛ Which sector workers is APY for? → Unorganised sector
question_hi: असंगठित कार्यबल को राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना में शामिल होने हेतु प्रेरित करने के लिए जून 2015 में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वित्तीय समावेशन योजना शुरू की गई थी? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 1)

प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना
अटल पेंशन योजना
solution_hi:

Explanation:
अटल पेंशन योजना (APY) जून 2015 में शुरू की गई थी, जिसका उद्देश्य असंगठित क्षेत्र के श्रमिकों को राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली (NPS) में शामिल होने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करना था। यह योजना मुख्य रूप से उन लोगों के लिए है जो किसी संगठित पेंशन योजना में शामिल नहीं हैं। इसमें सरकार 5 वर्षों तक योगदानकर्ता के खाते में 50% योगदान देती है, अधिकतम ₹1000 प्रति वर्ष। यह योजना 18-40 वर्ष की आयु के व्यक्तियों के लिए है और 60 वर्ष की आयु में न्यूनतम ₹1000 प्रति माह की पेंशन सुनिश्चित करती है।

question: Which one of the following programmes is associated with the development of road transport in India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 1)
options: NREGP
MNREGA
Golden Quadrilateral
NRHM
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Golden Quadrilateral

Explanation:
The Golden Quadrilateral is a major highway project in India that connects the four major cities: Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata. This project was initiated by the Government of India to develop road transport and is implemented by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI). Its objective is to promote faster and safer travel across the country. Among the other options, NREGP and MNREGA are related to rural employment, while NRHM is associated with healthcare. Hence, the Golden Quadrilateral is the programme associated with the development of road transport in India.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा कार्यक्रम भारत में सड़क परिवहन के विकास से जुड़ा है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: NREGP
MNREGA
स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज
NRHM
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज

Explanation:
स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज भारत का एक प्रमुख राजमार्ग परियोजना है जो देश के चार प्रमुख शहरों दिल्ली, मुंबई, चेन्नई और कोलकाता को जोड़ती है। यह परियोजना भारत सरकार द्वारा सड़क परिवहन को विकसित करने के लिए शुरू की गई थी और इसे राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग प्राधिकरण (NHAI) द्वारा कार्यान्वित किया जाता है। इसका उद्देश्य देश भर में तेज और सुरक्षित यात्रा को बढ़ावा देना है। अन्य विकल्पों में NREGP और MNREGA ग्रामीण रोजगार से संबंधित हैं, जबकि NRHM स्वास्थ्य सेवा से जुड़ा है। अतः स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज सड़क परिवहन के विकास से जुड़ा कार्यक्रम है।

question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the National Social Assistance Programme? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 2)
options: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme
Annapurna
AYUSH
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is AYUSH

Explanation:
The National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) is a centrally sponsored scheme of the Government of India that provides financial assistance to the elderly, widows, and persons with disabilities living below the poverty line. It consists of five components: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme, Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme, Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme, Annapurna, and Maternity Benefit Scheme. AYUSH is a separate ministry and program dealing with Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy, and is not part of NSAP. Hence, the correct answer is 'AYUSH'.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was NSAP launched? → 1995
☛ Which ministry administers NSAP? → Ministry of Rural Development
☛ Objective of Annapurna scheme → Free food grains for the elderly
☛ Beneficiary of IGNDPS → Persons aged 18-79 years with severe disability
☛ Latest NSAP component → Maternity Benefit Scheme (added in 2011)
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम का हिस्सा नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (20/01/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विकलांगता पेंशन योजना
अन्नपूर्णा
आयुष
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है आयुष

Explanation:
राष्ट्रीय सामाजिक सहायता कार्यक्रम (NSAP) भारत सरकार द्वारा संचालित एक केंद्र प्रायोजित योजना है, जो गरीबी रेखा से नीचे के बुजुर्गों, विधवाओं और विकलांगों को वित्तीय सहायता प्रदान करती है। इसके तहत पांच घटक हैं: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना, इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना, इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विकलांगता पेंशन योजना, अन्नपूर्णा और मातृत्व लाभ योजना। आयुष आयुर्वेद, योग, यूनानी, सिद्ध और होम्योपैथी से संबंधित एक अलग मंत्रालय और कार्यक्रम है, जो NSAP का हिस्सा नहीं है। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 'आयुष' है।
